context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-tenant architecture fully implemented and tested. Key components: 1) TenantMiddleware resolves tenant from X-Tenant-ID header > JWT token > demo fallback. 2) Public paths bypass middleware: /api/health, /api/tenants/create, /api/tenants/check-subdomain. 3) Demo tenant uses existing test_database, new tenants get tenant_{id} databases. 4) Frontend AuthContext manages login/logout with localStorage persistence. 5) LoginPage has Sign In and Create Tenant tabs. 6) Sidebar shows tenant info bar and user bar with logout. Test IDs: login-page, login-tab, register-tab, tenant-select, login-email, login-password, login-submit, reg-company, reg-subdomain, reg-email, reg-password, register-submit, tenant-info-bar, user-bar, logout-btn, nav-* for all pages.
